steps.title: Add the shared automation model for tests, screen plays and port targets
steps.why: One place for the new screens to read and write test cases and runs.

steps.title: Build the Agent Control screen with scenario switching and injection
steps.why: The person wants mocks driven by an agent and wants to watch it happen.

steps.title: Build the API Test Bench and run real requests through the proxy
steps.why: WireMock-style full API testing with pass/fail results.

steps.title: Build Screen Play & MCP with platform port config and copyable harness setup
steps.why: Sync an iOS/Android UI test with response injection on the configured port.

steps.title: Add the Map Local connector pipeline and wire all new pages into the sidebar
steps.why: See how a rule flows from match to response and how tools connect.

steps.title: Build, take pictures, run the final comparison check and write the summary
steps.why: Prove the new screens really draw and nothing regressed.

params.text: DONE: The automation layer is built and verified. The Proxzy POC now has four new pages: Agent Control (rule picker, scenario chips, Live bypass, token injection, session start/end, engine restart, control feed, endpoint contract), API Test Bench (suite editor, method/URL/header/body/inject/scenario fields, header assertion, run-one/run-all through the real loopback proxy via system curl, JSON import/export, WireMock mappings export), Screen Play & MCP (editable engine/device steps, real hit checkpoints, simulated taps clearly marked, iOS/Android/Android-emulator port targets, MCP/Playwright/XCTest/Espresso/Env tabs, play JSON import/export) and the Map Local Connector pipeline (six-stage device→engine→match→scenario→injection→response strip, harness command, match/scenario/injection cards, response preview, tokens, scoped cURL). cargo test: 50 passed, 0 failed. cargo build: succeeds (19 pre-existing warnings). rebuild_check: build passed, app-screenshot passed at 2880×1664, 'This would pass.' Proof shots: app/shots/studio-agent.png, studio-tests.png, studio-tests-run.png (4 mocked API tests passed in 43–78 ms through the real proxy), studio-screen.png, studio-screen-run.png (runner executed engine steps, marked device steps simulated, paused at a hit checkpoint), studio-map-pipeline.png, studio-map-table.png, studio-guide.png. Traps: views.rs, rules_ui.rs and studio_ui.rs are textually included into app.rs, so never add mod declarations for them; studio.rs is a real module in main.rs. Sample Map Local rules stay off by default (map_enabled=false); explicit runs auto-arm, and the Tests page has an Arm engine chip. Screen-play ExpectHit waits for new traffic after the step starts, not cumulative hits. Never touch /Applications/Proxyman.app, build only inside app/, and do not start dev servers or watchers. Open questions about the original Proxyman's exact layout/visuals remain unknowable under clean-room rules. Next move: none required.
